title: Add Redis/BullMQ queue

context.summary: Create queue abstractions, BullMQ implementation, processing job creation flow and worker base runner.
context.background: TASK-6 added object storage abstractions. TASK-7 adds the async processing queue layer before document upload and processors are implemented.

in: Define processing job queue and worker interfaces in @mindory/core.
Define a processing job store interface for durable PostgreSQL state integration.
Add a ProcessingJobDispatcher that creates durable jobs before enqueueing BullMQ work.
Implement BullMQ queue and worker adapters in @mindory/queue-bullmq.
Add a worker base runner that marks durable job state around processor execution.
Wire worker app base runner helpers without implementing concrete processors.
Add queue validation to repository checks.
Update worker, architecture and configuration documentation.
out: Implement document upload, scan or processor logic.
Start workers from Docker Compose runtime.
Apply migrations or connect to a live Redis/Postgres during validation.
Install dependencies if pnpm is unavailable in the local environment.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/core exports processing job queue payload, queue, worker, store and processor contracts.
ProcessingJobDispatcher creates a durable job through ProcessingJobStore before enqueueing queue work.
ProcessingJobRunner marks jobs running, succeeded and failed around processor execution.
@mindory/queue-bullmq exports BullMQ queue and worker adapters configured by Redis URL and queue prefix.
BullMQ enqueue uses idempotency key as jobId and configures retry/backoff options.
apps/worker exports base runner helpers but no concrete processors.
Documentation explains Redis/BullMQ is execution scheduling only and PostgreSQL remains canonical job state.
No concrete document processors, DB repositories, API endpoints or Docker runtime changes are implemented.

manual_checks: Confirm BullMQ payloads use idempotency keys as jobId.
Confirm no concrete processors, DB repositories, API endpoints or Docker runtime changes were added.

risks: Local pnpm is unavailable in the current environment, so BullMQ and TypeScript execution may need to wait until dependencies are installed.
The queue layer cannot be exercised against Redis until a later task adds runnable workers and repositories.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
